items.source_text: Ohhh Wow this one left on a cliff i was not expecting. I feel like we are about to see John lose his temper in a big way. Excited for the next one.
Fun! I think this was the best one yet! I absolutely love Marcy! She’s so fun and Bram so so yum haha!

The Battles Are Epic The Battles Are Epic. An amazing last story for this series. The battles were so well written I felt like I was there. My heart raced. Ms. Vickers's characters are so real. Her plotline is flawless. I loved this series and am a little sad that this is the last book. But I know that Ms. Vickers will keep on writing so that I can enjoy more of her amazing creativity.

Not What I Expected I really wanted to like this story, based on it's sales history....but  it's simplistic plotting and superficial stereotypical characters made it an effort to get into...though the ending was stronger.  Don't think the recruiting effort of the pilot was realistic, even if the pilot was desperate to get out of the boredom of retirement. Thinking on the fly is great, but not as the main planning of an attack. Intriguing title, just expected more.
Wally Lamb fan I am a Wally Lamb fan, and this book did not disappoint.  Quirky characters and lots of psychology.  I seldom give anything a 5.

Mr. Willmott isn't as dynamic as Miss Pettigrew I love this series. It kind of sneaks up on you and grabs you from behind. Fortunately, Miss Pettigrew in her own disagreeable self is also featured in this book. Mr. Willmott wasn't much but we had Miss Pettigrew so who cares. I'm a little bothered by Emily who can't read, drive, or walk far. Her injuries and difficulties aren't consistent. Also, where is the insurance from the car accident if it wasn't her fault?

Surprisingly good I wondered how the two characters were going to end up together (after all, it is a romance). Well, the author surprised me by bringing them together in a believable way. It's a Regency, Napoleonic era romance and quite different than most romances of the period. It is well written, has pleasant surprises and turns, and introduces God but in a natural way for believers without being heavy on religion. Overall, I strongly recommend it.

Chance for Love I knew this was just a novella, but I figured I'd better read it so I could keep up with the story lines.  It's a much shorter story, but a good one just the same.  I did wish it was a little longer.  How it figures in to the rest of the series remains to be seen.
Great! Continue reading the series!  One of the best series out there now.  Well written, well plotted, good character development etc.
There's only one McGuffey's A wealth of information.  A young person taught from these would have a great foundation for life.
Mystery I enjoyed this book.  It kept me guessing until the end.  I recommend it to anyone who enjoys a good read.

I love her books but the romance parts are hard to ... I love her books but the romance parts are hard to get through. Kind of tiresome and annoying?? But I'm no longer a teen either. HA!

Rediculous Story Horrible... I don't get all the rave reviews. The first half was so awful Spoilers......

"Nix's" family is killed and the story is told in a back and forth flashback form. Someone is after her, or was it her hubby? She gets baddazx and it's back and forth like this. Reliving her family's death. And then if that weren't bad enough the "killers' come and kill her dog! But she's a baddazx and has talking guns and will get her revenge..... meh not for me

Insightful Look into the Rise & Rule of Hatshepsut Insightful, academic look at this wonderful (in an Egyptian way) woman, her remarkable rise to power and ability to rule...especially in Egypt.

Dr. Cooney, has added the reality of living in those times (how quickly or easily we forget the miracle of medicine) throughout her look into the rise and reign of Hatshepsut.

Now the bad part: a touch dry and, at times, too didactic.

Still, for all of us budding Egyptolo
Good read, particularly if you like sy-fi series. I am really enjoying this series. This is a fun read - start with the firs book in the series AUORA and read on.
How could I resist a librarian story? Another enjoyable visit to Sweetwater Springs. I liked meeting Lacy and seeing Paris again - they make a cute couple!
Hard to put down Fast paced action with many twists and turns. I would recommend this book to anyone who enjoys an easy enjoyable read and a great way to spend a day.

Alice: Brotherhood Protectors World (Boswell Group Book 6) Another great story. It had the twist in it that was just wonderful. Enough romance to be sweet and sexy without detracting from the rest of the book.

Kathleen Willey had a lot of terrible things happen to her because of the Clintons Kathleen Willey had a lot of terrible things happen to her because of the Clintons.  After reading her book, I would NEVER vote for Hillary.  She and Bill are pathological liars and very dangerous to be around or to lead our country.

Liz Adair writes a nice tale. No profanity or sexuality Liz Adair writes a nice tale.  No profanity or sexuality.  Good clean adventure.  The ending was a bit of a surprise.  The author led me down a few rabbit holes and blind alleys.  I had it all wrong.  The cousin is not what he appeared to be.  Great characters and a great plot.  Looking forward to reading more books of hers in the future.

Goes round and round An interesting story about dreaming. One trouble with this is that the reader doesn't know the reality from the dream. It is somewhat confusing. It is a strange premise though. If you have ever watched and enjoyed a long movie, only to say at the end, now why did I sit all the way through that, you will repeat that at the end of this book. If there was a second book in a series, I don't think I would go for it. This one is enough. However, try it and see what you think.
Belmary House Book One More than just a time travel and romance, but caught up in circumstances more paranormal yet to be defined completely.
Tough But Important Read http://predators.nhl.com/club/blogpost.htm?id=35731

Good overview about payday lending Good overview about the payday industry- Really bad that firms take advantage of the poor. They will pay a price at the end. But also the poor need to be financially educated and hold things off. Of course, it is never easy but this is America and people have risen out of poverty. In addition, not all payday is bad. Banks don't do small loans or people with very low credit score. So payday lending will exist and provide some value. However, they should not goug
Simply WOW! This book is a must read, keep and share book! You can't put it down until the end ! So looking forward to the next book.!
Easy fun read Fresh plot line with a few unexpected twists. Enjoyed the casual feel and slightly insecure human characters. Uniquely cozy read.
No One is Like Raymond Chandler Los Angeles in the golden age, written by one of the great crime novelists.
Grandaughter liked it. Most things I Review I say yep or nope. So I’m short about 19 0r so words for your review.

Writer cant spell Interesting story but I cannot imagine the writer ever took, (or passed), a high school course in composition.  You could find better walking down the ISLES of a supermarket.  At 99 cents it was almost worth the price.

🤔 It was ok but a little to much like ice planet barbarians by ruby dixon... only differences major really are the climate of the planet and that the male lead in this story was on the space ship that crashed with the girls, other than that pretty much the same... except I personally like ruby Dixon's better plus it's on kindle free .. however  having said that if you enjoyed IPB by  ruby then u will enjoy this and vice a versa ...

Wonderful read. A great story, kept me turning pages not wanting to put it down.
Looking forward to reading the full series.

Holy Smokes  - I can't believe what I just read Every single time I read a Hoover book I'm left with the lingering thoughts of "where does she get her ideas".  This book was no exception, maybe even more of "holy smokes, I can't believe I just read that and why can't I stop reading."  This is yet another story that has you flying all over the place with what's going to happen next, all the way to the very end.  Grab a glass of wine and put your seatbelt on, this one is going to take you for one
Good read Had me wondering what would happen next. Would she win or lose and how would it look. Keep me wanting to know what happened next.
Great story! Another great Melinda Leigh story. If you haven't read them yet, you need too'  She keeps you glued to the book!

England during the great air war The time period is short but the people involved lived many life times in one summer.  The fears, the scramble to try be normal in a very war time situation was described in painful detail.  The Kindle book was a joy to read, but you have to understand some of the English phrases and terms.  This is not a book of lust during war time, but of love and duty often conflicting and wearing the mind down.

Oh da lolly Great, great series. I was sad to read the last page. These books have all the suspense, honor, glory, love and sadness I think one can endure. The only thing that maybe, just maybe being that of my humble opinion could have been added is more depth to the villain. Mr. Fuller could write a book about the beginning before the crushing blow to the ...if we are lucky
Not for me Maybe you need to be a fan of reality tv to enjoy this although 25 to love had its share of lol moments. I still couldn't get into it.
A pleasant read This was a pleasant, easy to read fairy tale. I read it in two evenings with my children. All of us enjoyed the story.

Most working people have been busy with jobs, kids ... Most working people have been busy with jobs, kids etc. This is a reference book on all the things you need to address when you get ready to retire. Each question is explained in a paragraph or few and then a book or web link is provided for detailed learning about the particular subject. I do suggest anyone retired or nearing it, read this book.

Major character death. Akira faces magic and continues the quest for the stone. Ends on a cliffhanger. Mate is used 49 times, alpha is mentioned 14 times. Akira's relationships and friendships grow.
A great story especially for the price! This a great action-packed story on the sea! Well worth the $3.03 being asked for.....loved the audiobook as well..... This is one that won't disappoint you!

A real vintage mystery This is a good clean vintage mystery. It held my interest and was also set in an area I only moved from in 06. One scene was a block from my 41-year home. While that was fun, it was also a kick to hear of the interest in vintage clothing which seemed well-researched by the author. A 1940's Lanvin coat is the center of this story and when Joanna, the owner of Tallulah's Closet, buys it from a former Mary's Club stripper, the action starts almost immediately. It's worth the

Great but long I still plan to read the rest of the series but reading the first 6 like one long book- was not as compelling, I think. However, this story is interesting and covers all ranges of emotions. Earth attacked, alien worlds, hybrids, robots, portals, it just keeps creating. That is where my interest lies--what new race, place, threat, or discovery be?

More of the Same Excellence. If you've read my reviews on any of the previous C.T. Ferguson series then you know what I think of this one.  Actually, each one has an improved storyline over it's predecessor. I hope it continues because I'm off to read about someone who is supposedly "Already Guilty". The absolute worse part of this series is that I'm reading them faster than Tom Fowler can write them. Kind of like "binge watching" an excellent TV series.

Fantastic This series — and this book — is great.  Fantastic world building, characters that you care about, and a good plot. It’s well edited and I didn’t notice even a single typo or error, which is rare.  It absolutely made my week when I noticed the new book was out, and I immediately left the other books I am reading to read this one straight through.  If I have any gripes about the book (and I don’t really), it’s that this book seemed short and no doubt the time until the next one will see

Highly recommend to anyone that’s ever played and ENJOYED an RPG ... This book is strange... and ridiculously refreshing and entertaining. An absolute page turner based on pure astonishment and intrigue haha. Highly recommend to anyone that’s ever played and ENJOYED an RPG before

DO NOT RECOMM I ordered this at the recommendation of Jenna Bush Hager from the Today Show. The story bounces back and forth (from times past by denoting hours and minutes on a clock) and times present (by date after the event. I am an avid reader, primarily historic fiction, but after one week, I have only read 80 pages. I doubt I will finish it.

Thriller Harry and Gina, traveling RN's, take an assignment that is killer in a  remote location outside Virginia City, Nevada.. Creepy hospital, creepy staff, a mad scientist chief of staff and  severely ill patients who are literally discards from an Alzheimer drug trial . What Gina uncovers is horrific. The ending is fast and furious.

but in the end I really enjoyed Roar. I have a lot of questions about ... I am a huge fan of Cora Carmack's Rusk University series so I was very excited for her foray into YA.  I was a bit slow to get into Roar with the the weather magic - I just didn't get it at first, but in the end I really enjoyed Roar.  I have a lot of questions about how the storms "work" and I can't wait for another book to get some answers!  Roar is a fantastic heroine and I am looking forward to reading more abo
The Harmony of Holly Willa and Cactus story. I enjoyed the forgiveness, the family dynamics, the dogs, and Mitch. Great series so far. Good clean romance.

Not as suspenseful as the description makes it out to be Read this because it’s on kindle unlimited. It’s ok. I could easily put it down and wasn’t jumping to continue reading like I do with really good books. Storyline was good enough but pretty easy to figure out halfway through. Usually I can’t stop reading  a good book but this one I could easily put down. If you enjoy reading in general def worth reading.

Not your typical "alien invasion" tale.... Humans don't always win... This series provides a much more realistic viewpoint of what would REALLY happen if Earth were to face an alien invasion. Lots of action, intrigue, science, and still enough human politics to show how stupid the typical human is.
Read them all for an alternative to the the normal "humans win because we WISH hard enough" type of science fiction.

Good book Claimed by Her Monsters was a good book and I enjoyed reading it. There was a few things I didn't like and you can tell by Avery writing the story was rushed. Despite that though, Avery created a world that I was immersed in and desperately want more of.

Great read This was a quick great read. The characters were well developed and exciting to follow in the story. Can’t wait to read more from this author.

I received a free copy of this book and am voluntarily leaving a review.
Good read Very fast paced.  Vexing in that so many characters are introduced with no background info.  Guess it's one way to encourage further reads.
This book was recommended to me It is well written and easy to read. It is just not my field of interest so was unable to finish it.
Good series Aunt Peg has Melanie attend the committee for the dog club and someone gets murdered.  Can Melanie figure it out?  Also her ex husband returns with his own issues.
Great read Possibly my favorite author.  Wish he wrote more books for adults
but a good ride nevertheless A touch formula driven, but a good ride nevertheless. Did not care for the ending.
Great Science Fiction Book If you like Science Fiction, this is a great book!

A thought provoking book This book really makes you take a look at yourself. Self examination is usually hard, if you're honest. We can all be better humans. Kinder, more forgiving, sharing more, giving of our time, there are a whole lot of things we can all work on. Just think how we can each enrich this earth. And then, all this goodness comes back to us ten fold! All these thoughts came to me through the reading of this book. What an encouraging and thought provoking book! Thank you, Catherin

Chronicles of an Urban Druid series Just discovered this series. Wonderful, exciting books. They keep you laughing and wishing the world was this much fun. Intriguing thoughts of how the world could be.
EL COLOR DE LA VIDA Sensible lienzo de la vida de una mujer apasionada que al regresar a su pasado descubre la complejidad en el comportamiento de los seres humanos.

Liked the book as a whole Liked the book as a whole, didn't particularly care about all the side characters that take up most of the book.  I just didn't think they added enough to warrant such a huge number of pages.  Still, I had fun reading it and will definitely be picking up any more.

too improbable This is a romping stomping novel about two hippie treasure hunters back in the early 80s.  The plot gets so twisted and the solutions to the problems seem so evident (without all the included drama) that it gets annoying at times.  Then too the resolution to these troubles are very unlikely at best. It reads more like an old screenplay but without the visuals for the comedic parts it falls rather flat.

Just finished 4 and 5. 5 Made me tear ... Just finished 4 and 5. 5 Made me tear up a bit 1/3 of the way through. Loving the way the story is playing out.

Also. Bro. I'm gonna die falling off these cliffhangers
Thus was as an awesome book. It had emotion Thus was as an awesome book.  It had emotion, suspense, mystery and surprise that the reader did not see coming.

Intriguing scenario Really interesting story.  This made me think about things I had never considered regarding serious allergies.  I certainly never thought of the scenario that the author plays out.

but i liked the first one I did not read this book, but i liked the first one. I will not get this book until they get more reasonable about the price $8.99 is way too much for a Virtual book. I would love to Finish I the series, but it is too rich for my blood.
Thank you for a good first book.
Dan

The Human What a conclusion! In this third and final
installment to the Children of Wisdom series we begin just about where we left off in The Reaper.
I was slightly disappointed with the epilogue, but don't want to give anything away. Wouldn't be at all disappointed if a fourth book for the series came out. 😉

WONDERFUL ADDITION TO THE SERIES This is the first full length Murderbot novel and it's just as tightly paced and complex as earlier entries. Murderbot has a phenomenally snarky voice and a growing social net that at time baffles as much as it enriches the character. I read it too fast the first time so, yes, I'm going to re-read it immediately. It's beautifully written. My pick for a Hugo.

Good story line Good story line....but....the story just ended abruptly. At there very end, there was no mention of the match maker, no answers to what their future will really be. And there was no mention of Ridley and Dolan. But otherwise, a good story

A bitter end to a noble struggle - or is it? Fawstin's THE INFIDEL reminds me in many ways of Frank Miller's THE DARK KNIGHT RETURNS: dark, somber, and extremely violent. Instead of an array of supervillains and their henchmen, though, Fawstin's Pigman (and his creator) face a sea of enemies, some as close as family - because they are. Not a tale for the fainthearted. Hopefully there will be more tales of Pigman to come.

One of My Favorite Books The Harry Potter books are delightful. This one is great, though I do dislike the mirror as it seems a plot point that was faulty. Other than that this was a pleasant read and very magical

This book really lays it out like it is This book really lays it out like it is.  God is amazing but sometimes we have to proclaim that in impossibly difficult places and circumstances for His glory...  Kate McCord gets it right in this book!

A book in which women of courage, can relate. This book tells the story of a woman and her family, who followed her husband (a dreamer) to the Dakota prairie to homestead. After which their lives changed forever.

Awesome read This is a really great series. I agree that this is a cross between Big Bang Theory and Star Gate. Well written, characters are developed well. You fall in love with some and dislike others. It's not all science fiction, there is a lot of political stimulation and some mystery. A must read.

I Bought Both Books After just Reading the First Chapter. Look I know both Oriental and Martial Arts Customs. Plus I had been an Orphan. From a young age. Now after reading the first book. I am really impressed. Can't wait to get to more stories.

dray

Typical Carl Hiaasen that I know and love. Southern Florida intrigue Typical Carl Hiaasen that I know and love. Southern Florida intrigue, entertaining and an enjoyable read. Skinny Dip might still be my favorite though.

Good First Book in the Series Sandra Baublitz has set her first book in the Dog Detective Series where else but a dog show.  Although the idea of a dog who never competed before performing as well as Law did is unreal, the mystery itself was solid.  Looking forward to book two.
Holy mutha bleepin!! OMG!! This story had me hook line and sinker right from the beginning. V-card given in some crazy exchange. If you love hot raunchy sex this is the book and author for you!
Keep the story going! Loved it. Complexity story keeps you engaged.  Description and depth characters are so clearly made real.  Ending left me hanging, wanting more. More, more please.

Too much bad language for me Too much bad language for me,  however, enjoyed the idea and story.  Didn't like ending.  Should not have cut it off that way.  Finish the idea and prepare the reader for the next step.
Good easy read Laughs and tears throughout the read. But I cry at commercials on TV!
Loved it. Great romance. Looking forward to reading others by this author.

The book you won't put down! Thoroughly enjoyed! Will be reading again! Robert doesn't disappoint! One of the things I love about his writing is that I am challenged. So grab a dictionary (if like me) and get ready!

An enjoyable read with well-developed characters This was not a tremendously complicated story, but it held my attention because it included the thoughts and fears of the characters, making them much more complete. Steam level: medium. Not sweet and clean but not too much explicit sex either. The extended epilogue wrapped up the loose ends nicely.

I'm not even done reading it! Great characters, well developed diverse personalities. Intriguing story. I do not reveal spoiler information so, the only thing I will add to this is that Not all is as it seems to be.

Like I said, I'm not even done with it. It's one of those books that when you put it down, you find yourself still thinking about the story and characters. Enjoy it

Another stunning tale. James Rollins is my favorite author. I love his way of weaving science, religion, ancient artifacts, intrique, relationships, military hunks and strong powerful women into some of the most amazing stories. Love everything he has written and always look forward to the next novel. Would love to see new stories in the Sanguine Series! Hint hint!
Louie It is a very quick read and in the first person.The first person being the dog Louie. It's  all about his life from nursing puppy to first birthday.
Great Really enjoyed the third book to this series. Dawson and Lenix are awesome...would love to read stories about the rest of the band and to see where lenix and Dawson end up
Wonderful story This story line was amazing. I loved the characters and the whole angel/demon story line. I also loved the ancestry  elements and the ending was fantastic.
Wow Can't get enough of the sisters and their men. I'm going to start the next book immediately. Keep going Christine
Jaw dropping Epic story, I didn't want it to end. Another book in the series over, yet a broader horizon is waiting. Time to jump in even deeper for more

Another fine mess for Bob and Nikki You can go home again, but it's just not the same as it was before. Bob and Nikki try for a quiet vacation at home, and Murphy comes to call, in his 12" Doc Martins.

Better than t.v. The book is better than the t.v. show by far, of course that's usually how that works. Books should remain books, because for the most part they fail at recreating a really good story and this just so happens to be a pretty good story. Sadly, I can relate with Hanna Baker in some ways.

Another winner from Alexander McCall Smith An exceptional story from a winning author. All of the characters in the Scotland Street series become the friends we love to meet and make us laugh during the good times and not so good. They are truly credible, especially during their gatherings . I have read all of his stories, most several times.
The ending with a poem always makes me want to be in Edinburgh for the next one.
The art of writing good literature is a true gift . Long may

Suspense and Exciting Most of the story has the FBI agent in hospital recovering from a bad wound. Tess works on a crime whole in bed. The characters are very realistic and entertaining, including Cat, Tess good friend. The killings ends up the killers uncovered at the end. A great book!

Free read for honest review. Not sure about this book I just couldn't stay interested. Maybe the characters or subject were not my type.
I received this book for free through Reading Deals for my honest review.

Just started this book While I am just starting to read this book, it has great promise and excellent writing so I think for sure I will like it very much.  Hope to finish soon because it is that kind of book.

Good but ending could've been better Most of the book made me want to keep reading. It's definitely written in an older style. I'm interested in the TV show since I wasn't satisfied with the ending. I felt like it built up to nothing big happening.
Now you see me, now you don't Great thriller and love story. Better than the first book . Can't wait to read book number three.
Amazing book Enjoyed book thoroughly. Really hit on some real life issues with abuse and spousal abuse. But it also hits on how abuse happens. It's a great love story. I really enjoyed it.

Great read It goes with out saying book is better than the TV movie, though I like the movie which is why I bought the book. It was an easy read got it done in just over ten hours, so apparently it kept my attention. I truly can't wait to dive into the rest of the collection.
Mile 81 As always with Stephen King, he scares the crap out of you with his scenarios. But, also as usual well written.
I am ready for the next one Suspense, twists, and great characters.  Maggie and Ryder might be a match.  What more can we ask for.  Hurry up and release #3 Alex

liked I really liked the premise and the MCs but something held me back from loving it. Maybe it was the whole town bullying the FMC - that seemed so far fetched it pushed me out of that suspension of disbelief zone. It’s possible we’ll find out why in book 2, but that doesn’t help with book 1.
Strange I didn't really like the book, yet  I couldn't put it down .  needed to know what happened!  Very different!
Matters of the Heat A really captivating plot and a great book - couldn't put it down!!

She's got this When Bailey learns about Dr. Russell’s past, she turns a new page. She shows him how strong of a woman she really is. She decides she is going to put her sister first and focus on her career. What will Dr. Russell do? This series just keeps getting better and you will be anxious for the next book.
I am voluntarily leaving my honest review for the arc copy that I received.
Not one of my fave. Just okay. They got boring & sappy.

Bomb! This was bomb! Good God was that satisfying! Titillating from start to finish. Never did I expect to enjoy a book about a pilot and flight attendant/fledgling author, but damn it! This was good! Sizzling, in fact. And so far the first erotic romance I’ve read that isn’t borderline baseless or obscene. Whitney G. officially has new fan! Now let me get back to fantasizing about Jake Weston.
I liked this book. The characters were likeable and believable. Just enough twists and turns to keep you guessing. I will read mor by Greg Enslen. Thanks!

Not really my taste To much horror, it is just so bleak and hopeless, that i was struggling to finish this one. It may be for you if your into horror, but i like my nightmares just fine the way they are 😉
Great read Really enjoyed this book. I felt like I was living in their town.

Unorthodox Match Let me start by saying that I have never read anything by Naomi Ragen. I'm glad that this was my first book by her...

This is a story of loss in many forms, death, infidelity etc...and how we get through these losses to find some peace. Because Ms Ragen is writing about a subject (Orthodox Judaism) that I know nothing about, I appreciated the glossary of terms in the book.

Many thanks to Netgalley and St Martin's Press for this advanced readers copy. Thi

Horror and fear This book starts off with the appearance of large mysterious black shiny rocks. The rocks are a mystery. What are they and why are people dying when they touch them? They are opening up portals all over the world and people are dying and creatures are taking over. Who will survive and be victorious? Will it be them or the human race? Well written but I will admit it scared the hell out of me.
Another Great Read! These books are so fun to read. I love them because they are well written, have good copy editing and are a nice storyline. What more could you ask for! :-)

Surprise ending The story begins 50 years after the end of World War II introducing the reader to women who married during the war who are traveling to a reunion in an English town. Then the narrative switches to the earlier intertwining lives of these women who became brides during the 1940s. They are a diverse group with many issues thrown together for many reasons. Many questions of the reader are neatly cleared up at the end of the book but there seems to be no guilt or remorse over a murder

Two broken hearts Not wanting a wife but needing a mother for his daughter, he is pressured to get a .an order bride. Widowed recently responsible for her mother and her daughter she was facing eviction from her home because she cannot pay the mortgage. Being a mail order bride is what she decided to do. Both want just friendship but will they be able to blend their families, even find love?
Disease Such a good book. I learned so much about how we treat each other that have a disease. Really a good ending.

Makes total sense Some of the things I should avoid are things that made me feel bad and have been avoiding anyway. I have seen an energy improvement already and have not gone full bore on the plan yet. Love having a digital copy to be able to look at it anywhere I go.

This series is a mush read. There are six books in this series. Invasion Alaska, California, USA, Colorado, New Your, and China.
